sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Notwithstanding + 名詞／名詞片語、Only after + 子句／片語置首的倒裝、Whether or not / Even if、Would rather + 原形動詞 + than + 原形動詞、No later than / No earlier than
sections.markdown:
主題：**Notwithstanding + 名詞／名詞片語、Only after + 子句／片語置首的倒裝、Whether or not / Even if、Would rather + 原形動詞 + than + 原形動詞、No later than / No earlier than**

### 規則 1｜Notwithstanding + 名詞／名詞片語

notwithstanding 表示「儘管」，正式商務文件常見；可置於名詞片語前，與 although + 完整子句區分。

> Notwithstanding the delay, the original payment terms remain valid.

### 規則 2｜Only after + 子句／片語置首的倒裝

Only after 引導的時間限制片語置於句首時，主句通常使用助動詞倒裝。

> Only after the broker submitted the permit did customs release the cargo.

### 規則 3｜Whether or not / Even if

whether or not 表示「不論是否」；even if 表示「即使」，可用來強調條件不影響主句結果。

> The inspection fee is payable whether or not the shipment is released.

### 規則 4｜Would rather + 原形動詞 + than + 原形動詞

would rather 後接原形動詞；比較兩種行動時可用 than + 原形動詞。

> We would rather wait for clearance than pay an unapproved surcharge.

### 規則 5｜No later than / No earlier than

no later than 表示最晚期限；no earlier than 表示最早不得早於的時點，意思不同。

> Submit the permit no later than Friday; collection cannot begin earlier than Monday.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Damage Claim — Change of Position and Conditional Credit
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Customer: The replacement monitors arrived with cracked screens. Can you waive the inspection charge right away?
> Agent: Under our standard policy, the charge cannot be waived before the damage is verified.
> Customer: That is disappointing. The boxes were damaged when the courier handed them over.
> Agent: In that case, there may be another option. My supervisor can consider a one-time $35 credit if you email the delivery photos by 3 P.M. and the inspection confirms damage on arrival.
> Customer: So the credit is guaranteed once I send the photos?
> Agent: Not quite. The photos allow us to review the request; the inspection result and supervisor's approval are still required.
> Customer: Understood. I'll send the photos and keep the packaging.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Customs Release — Flight Hold and Backup
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Logistics Coordinator: We cannot use Monday's 9 A.M. flight. Customs still needs the import permit, and the broker expects to receive it at noon Monday.
> Warehouse Manager: The carrier offered Tuesday at 2 P.M., but the customs release must be confirmed by 4 P.M. Monday to keep that space.
> Logistics Coordinator: Once release is confirmed, packing takes ninety minutes. The temperature logger also needs to be activated before loading.
> Warehouse Manager: Then do not confirm Tuesday yet. Put it on a temporary hold and ask the broker for an update at 3 P.M. Monday.
> Logistics Coordinator: If clearance takes longer, Wednesday at 11 A.M. is the next available flight.
> Warehouse Manager: Good. Please note that Wednesday is a backup, not a new confirmed departure.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Claims Hotline — Processing Time and Exceptions
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Announcer: Thank you for calling Northbridge International Service. From Monday, November 2, through Friday, November 6, our claims desk will operate from 8 A.M. to 6 P.M. local time. Domestic repair estimates are normally sent within two business days after inspection; international estimates require up to five business days. Emergency replacement requests must be approved by the claims team and cannot be authorized by the telephone agent. Customers with a prepaid return label should use the link in their case email. If you have not received a label, please do not ship the item yet. For product-safety concerns, press 2 to speak with our safety desk. For all other claims, use the online case portal.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Cross-Border Shipment Terms, Import Documents and Provisional Customs Release
sections.markdown:
限時：**12 分 0 秒**。

### Arbor Freight — Cross-Border Shipment Terms (October 20, 2026)

> ARBOR FREIGHT — CROSS-BORDER SHIPMENT TERMS
Issued: October 20, 2026

Base freight: $145 per insulated crate. Confirmed shipments of eight or more crates receive a 12% discount on the base freight subtotal only.
Other first-invoice charges: customs documentation $95; cold-chain handling $180; cargo insurance $70. These charges are not discountable.
The planned delivery deadline is Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 6 P.M.
An $80 late-delivery credit may be granted only if (a) the carrier misses the delivery deadline AND (b) the consignee provided ALL required import documents by Friday, October 30, at 3 P.M. An approved credit appears on the NEXT invoice, not the current invoice.
Requests to change crate quantities require written carrier acceptance by Friday, October 30, at 5 P.M. Cancellation requests must be received by Friday, October 30, at noon. A quantity-change extension does not extend the cancellation deadline unless explicitly stated.
The carrier is not responsible for customs holds caused by incomplete import documentation. An express-clearance surcharge requires separate written customer authorization.

用途：參考文件

### Eastmere Labs — Confirmed Order and Document Log

> EASTMERE LABS — SHIPMENT PURCHASE ORDER
Confirmed October 22, 2026
Order: eight insulated crates of demonstration materials, customs documentation, cold-chain handling, and cargo insurance.
Approved budget for the first invoice: $1,400.
Order status: CONFIRMED — eight crates. No express-clearance service included.

IMPORT DOCUMENT LOG
October 29, 11:00 A.M.: Commercial invoice and packing list uploaded; import permit missing.
November 2, 10:00 A.M.: Import permit received and complete document package confirmed by the broker.
Note: An automated portal receipt confirms upload only; it does not establish that the package was complete.

用途：參考文件

### Broker and Customer Email Thread — November 3, 2026

> From: Nia Chen, Customs Broker
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 8:20 A.M.
Subject: Eastmere shipment — revised clearance estimate
The missing permit arrived yesterday at 10 A.M. Customs may release the shipment on Thursday, November 5, but that estimate is provisional. Delivery on November 4 is no longer realistic. Because the complete documentation was received after the October 30 deadline, the contractual $80 late-delivery credit does not automatically apply. The customer may request an exception, but no waiver has been approved.

From: Owen Reed, Eastmere Labs
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 9:05 A.M.
Subject: Re: revised clearance estimate
Could you reduce the order to seven crates and add the $45 express-clearance option? Our budget remains $1,400. Please do not activate any extra-cost service until Finance authorizes it.

From: Mina Shah, Arbor Freight
Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 9:30 A.M.
Subject: Re: revised clearance estimate
We have recorded the request but have NOT accepted a quantity change or activated express clearance. The original cancellation deadline was not amended. I can ask Finance about the extra charge, but the existing eight-crate order remains in force until any change is accepted in writing.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 46、Day 47、Day 48**。

### 複習重點
- **Day 46：跨部門核准**：辨認物流提出加急方案與財務核准之間的差異，說明哪個狀態可計入正式帳單。
- **Day 47：例外資格**：比較原截止日與只對特定受影響者開放的延長期限。
- **Day 48：合約修訂**：分別指出被新通知改動的條款，以及仍有效的原條款。
- **Day 49：立場轉變**：從客服「無法直接豁免」到「可考慮條件性抵用額」的變化中，辨認所有核准條件。

### 錯題標籤
- `DETAIL`：明示細節
- `IMPLICATION`：言外之意
- `STANCE_CHANGE`：立場改變
- `CONDITION`：條件判斷
- `APPROVAL`：書面／主管核准
- `NEXT_ACTION`：下一步行動
- `CAUSE`：原因辨識
- `DEADLINE`：期限辨識
- `TIME`：時間資訊
- `UNCERTAINTY`：尚未確定
- `FALLBACK`：備用方案
- `DATE`：日期資訊
- `COMPARISON`：比較辨識
- `EXCEPTION`：例外條款
- `INSTRUCTION`：指示辨識
- `CALC`：數字計算
- `DISCOUNT`：折扣門檻
- `INVOICE`：帳單整合
- `BUDGET`：預算餘額
- `INTEGRATION`：跨文件整合
- `STATUS`：目前有效狀態
- `POLICY`：政策條款
- `INFERENCE`：推論
- `WORD_FORM`：詞性選擇
- `CONCESSION`：讓步關係
- `INVERSION`：倒裝句
- `PASSIVE`：被動語態
- `CONJUNCTION`：連接詞
- `VERB_PATTERN`：動詞句型
- `PREPOSITION`：介系詞
- `GERUND`：動名詞
- `CONTRAST`：對比
- `TIME_CLAUSE`：時間子句
- `SUBJUNCTIVE`：要求式假設語氣

- `WORD_ORDER`：語序

- `GRAMMAR`：文法

- `COLLOCATION`：固定搭配

quizzes.title: Damage Claim — Change of Position and Conditional Credit

questions.prompt: How does the agent’s position change during the conversation?

options.A: She agrees to waive all fees immediately.
options.B: She offers a possible exception after learning about the damaged boxes.
options.C: She decides the customer must purchase new monitors.
options.D: She transfers the claim to the courier without reviewing it.

questions.explanation: 客服一開始依標準政策無法直接免除費用；得知外箱受損後，提出可能的單次 $35 抵用額，但需條件成立。

questions.prompt: What must happen before the $35 credit can be approved?

options.A: The customer must pay the courier again.
options.B: The monitors must be returned by noon.
options.C: Photos must arrive by 3 P.M., damage on arrival must be confirmed, and a supervisor must approve.
options.D: The customer must buy an extended warranty.

questions.explanation: 照片需下午三點前寄達，檢驗確認到貨時受損，並由主管核准；寄照片本身不構成保證。

questions.prompt: What will the customer most likely do next?

options.A: Send photographs and retain the packaging.
options.D: Request a refund from the bank.

questions.explanation: 顧客最後說會寄送照片並保留包裝。

quizzes.title: Customs Release — Flight Hold and Backup

questions.prompt: Why is the Monday morning flight no longer possible?

options.B: The airline has canceled every flight.
options.C: The warehouse has no packing materials.
options.D: The required import permit is not yet available.

questions.explanation: 進口許可證預計週一中午才取得，無法搭乘週一上午九點航班。

questions.prompt: By when must customs release be confirmed to retain the Tuesday flight space?
questions.explanation: 承運商要求週一下午四點前確認海關放行，才可保留週二下午兩點機位。

questions.prompt: What does the manager ask the coordinator to do?

options.C: Temporarily hold Tuesday’s space and seek a broker update at 3 P.M. Monday.

questions.explanation: 主管要求先暫時保留週二機位，週一下午三點詢問報關行，尚不可正式確認。

questions.prompt: What is implied about the Wednesday flight?

options.A: It is only a fallback if customs clearance is delayed.
options.B: It is already confirmed for all shipments.

questions.explanation: 週三上午十一點只是備援選項，並非正式改期確認。

quizzes.title: Claims Hotline — Processing Time and Exceptions

questions.prompt: When will the temporary claims-desk hours be in effect?
How long may an international repair estimate take after inspection?
questions.explanation: 國際維修估價最多五個工作天；兩個工作天是國內案件。

questions.prompt: Who can approve an emergency replacement?
questions.explanation: 緊急替換須由理賠／申訴團隊核准，電話客服不能授權。

questions.prompt: What should a customer do if no prepaid return label has been received?

options.A: Wait and avoid shipping the item for now.
options.D: Send the item directly to the safety desk.

questions.explanation: 公告明確要求未收到預付退貨標籤前先不要寄出商品。

quizzes.title: Cross-Border Shipment Terms, Import Documents and Provisional Customs Release

questions.prompt: What is the discounted base freight subtotal for the confirmed shipment?
What is the total amount of the currently confirmed first invoice?
How much of the approved budget remains under the current order?
If the $45 express-clearance service were authorized without any other changes, what would the new total be?
Why does the shipment not automatically qualify for the $80 late-delivery credit?

options.A: The complete import documents were confirmed after October 30 at 3 P.M.
options.B: The order contains fewer than eight crates.
options.D: The credit is available only for domestic shipments.

questions.explanation: 進口許可證直到 11/2 10:00 才補齊，晚於 10/30 15:00；因此即使延遲送達，也不自動符合抵用額資格。

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the current status of the shipment?

options.B: Eight crates remain confirmed; the reduction request is pending.
options.C: Express clearance has already been activated.
options.D: The entire shipment has been canceled.

questions.explanation: 原訂八箱仍有效，七箱變更僅被記錄、尚未書面接受；加急服務也未啟用。

questions.prompt: What was the original deadline for submitting a cancellation request?
questions.explanation: 取消申請原期限是 10/30 12:00；不可與文件 15:00、數量變更 17:00 混淆。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the broker’s November 5 estimate?

options.B: It is an approved replacement for the cancellation deadline.
options.C: It means customs has already released the shipment.
options.D: It is provisional and depends on customs clearance.

questions.explanation: 信件說 customs may release on Nov 5，且 estimate is provisional，表示尚未保證放行或送達。

questions.prompt: Notwithstanding the unexpected customs delay, the payment terms will remain _____.
questions.explanation: remain 後需形容詞 effective，表示條款仍有效。

questions.prompt: Only after the broker submitted the permit _____ the shipment released.
questions.explanation: Only after 置首造成主句倒裝；被動語態用 was the shipment released。

questions.prompt: The inspection fee is payable _____ the shipment is released on schedule.
questions.explanation: whether or not + 子句表示不論是否準時放行都須付費。

questions.prompt: The manager would rather _____ for written approval than authorize an unbudgeted fee.
questions.explanation: would rather + 原形動詞 wait，than 後也可接原形。

questions.prompt: The completed import declaration must arrive no _____ than 3 P.M. on Friday.
questions.explanation: 固定片語 no later than 表示最晚期限。

questions.prompt: The consignee is responsible _____ submitting the import permit.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be responsible for + V-ing。

questions.prompt: _____ the shipment was insured, the policy excluded damage caused by improper packing.
questions.explanation: 後面是完整子句，使用 Although；Despite/In spite of 後需名詞或動名詞。

questions.prompt: The invoice will be revised once the quantity change _____ in writing.
questions.explanation: once 未來時間子句使用現在式；變更「被接受」用 is accepted。

questions.prompt: The customs officer requested that the corrected manifest _____ immediately.
questions.explanation: request that + 主詞 + 原形動詞；被動為 be submitted。

questions.prompt: The broker sent a second reminder because the required certificate had not _____ received.
questions.explanation: 過去完成被動為 had not yet been received。

questions.prompt: The carrier will reimburse only those expenses _____ were approved in advance.
questions.explanation: 先行詞 expenses 為物，關係代名詞 that 作主詞。

questions.prompt: The customer asked _____ the express-clearance option would affect the original insurance coverage.
questions.explanation: 間接疑問句「是否」用 whether，後接陳述語序。

questions.prompt: The revised arrival estimate is _____ on customs releasing the cargo by Thursday.
questions.explanation: be contingent on 表示取決於；句中後接 on。

questions.prompt: The finance team will review the surcharge _____ the broker confirms the final amount.
questions.explanation: as soon as + 子句，表示報關行確認金額後即審核。

questions.prompt: Had the import permit been submitted on time, the customer _____ eligible for the delay credit, provided the carrier also missed the deadline.
questions.explanation: 過去反事實條件：Had ... been submitted，結果用 might have been；仍須符合承運商延誤條件。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [1]?

options.A: The previous email-only process made it difficult to match evidence with individual claims.
options.B: Our sales team has expanded its showroom opening hours.
options.C: The company will stop offering international deliveries next month.
options.D: The new product catalog will be printed in December.

questions.explanation: 前句改用 portal，後句有案件編號與文件清單，A 說明舊 email 流程難追蹤的原因，語意最連貫。

questions.prompt: Which phrase best completes blank [2]?
questions.explanation: If additional evidence is needed，客戶將「被通知」；未來被動 will be notified。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [3]?

options.A: The office cafeteria accepts credit cards.
options.B: All customers will receive a refund without inspection.
options.C: For example, a shipment may arrive late because customs is waiting for missing import paperwork.
options.D: The new brochure is available in three languages.

questions.explanation: 前句說單純延誤不足以取得補償，後句要求核實文件期限；C 的海關缺件例子連接兩者。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best completes blank [4]?

options.A: It is acceptable to discard the box immediately.
options.B: The customer should contact the airline about seat assignments.
options.C: No photographs are necessary for a damage claim.
options.D: Do not remove shipping labels or protective inserts before taking photographs.

questions.explanation: 保留包裝後接 This helps the inspector，D 提供具體保存標籤與防護材料的作法，指涉清楚。

questions.prompt: Notwithstanding the delay, the original insurance policy remains _____.
questions.explanation: remain 後用形容詞 effective；notwithstanding + 名詞表示儘管。

questions.prompt: Only after the documents were verified _____ the broker authorize release.
questions.explanation: Only after 置首，主句用 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞；過去情境選 did。

questions.prompt: The manager would rather _____ for approval than pay the fee immediately.
questions.explanation: would rather + 原形動詞 wait。

questions.prompt: The revised form must be submitted no _____ than Friday at noon.
questions.explanation: no later than 表示最晚期限。

questions.prompt: What does the agent imply about Monday delivery?

options.A: It is guaranteed if the customer pays immediately.
options.B: It is not guaranteed because customs has not released the shipment.
options.C: It was canceled by the customer.
options.D: It will happen before the inspection.

questions.explanation: 客服可以申請優先檢查，但海關尚未放行，因此無法保證週一到貨。

questions.prompt: What will the agent do before the customer pays the priority fee?

options.C: Wait for Finance authorization and send an email.

questions.explanation: 客服說財務必須先核准，審核後才會寄 email。

questions.prompt: When will the tracking portal be unavailable?
What is true about new pickup requests made by phone during the outage?

options.C: They will require an express-service surcharge.
options.D: They can be submitted, but confirmation comes after restoration.

questions.explanation: 可電話提出新取件要求，但系統恢復後才會收到確認。

questions.prompt: What is the quoted total before any optional priority fee?
How much budget remains under the standard quote?

questions.prompt: What does a claim acknowledgment indicate?

options.B: The customer may ignore the deadline.
